<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Recipe kits delivered home: a picture beside the kit name, cooking time, the ingredients list, a portions
  radio group and the price with an add button. Axes: layout (rows, cards), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";
import type { DishOption } from "../components/option-chips.types";

export type RecipeKitsProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  dishes: Dish[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: FoodLabels;
  portions: DishOption[];
  layout?: "rows" | "cards";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import OptionChips from "../components/option-chips.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  dishes,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  portions,
  layout = "rows",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<RecipeKitsProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="package" :title="empty" />
    <Box v-else
      :class="
        (layout as string) === 'cards' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 md:grid-cols-3'
        : 'flex flex-col gap-8'
      "
      data-slot="items"
    >
      <Box v-for="d in dishes" :key="d.id"
        :class="
          (layout as string) === 'cards' ? 'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex flex-col gap-4 p-4'
          : 'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 p-6 md:grid-cols-2'
        "
        data-slot="item"
      >
        <MediaFrame :alt="d.name" ratio="4/3" />
        <Stack gap="4">
          <Group gap="2" class="flex-wrap">
            <Badge variant="secondary" size="default">
              <LucideIcon name="timer" :size="16" />
              {{ tpl(labels.minutes, (d.minutes == null ? undefined : String(d.minutes))) }}
            </Badge>
            <Badge v-if="d.badge" variant="outline" size="default">
              {{ d.badge }}
            </Badge>
          </Group>
          <Stack gap="2">
            <Text size="xl" weight="semibold">
              {{ d.name }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ d.summary }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <Stack gap="2">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ labels.ingredients }}
            </Text>
            <List tag="ul" class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 text-sm sm:grid-cols-2" data-slot="ingredients">
              <ListItem v-for="x in d.items" :key="x" class="flex items-center gap-2" data-slot="items-row">
                <LucideIcon name="check" :size="16" class="text-primary" />
                <Inline>
                  {{ x }}
                </Inline>
              </ListItem>
            </List>
          </Stack>
          <OptionChips :name="tpl('{0}-portions-{1}', id, d.id)" :legend="labels.portions" :options="portions" />
          <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="mt-auto">
            <Inline class="text-xl font-bold">
              {{ fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency) }}
            </Inline>
            <Button variant="default" size="default" type="button" :aria-label="tpl(labels.addOf, d.name)">
              {{ labels.add }}
            </Button>
          </Group>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
